tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the preceding five Assessment Years (AY 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copies of the Income Tax Returns (ITRs) for the mentioned Assessment Years, duly certified/signed by a Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Average Annual Turnover of Rs.2 Crores during last five financial years, i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Audited financial statements for the preceding five financial years, duly signed/certified by a Chartered Accountant, along with the UDIN.
Others -- Copy of the valid and active Company Registration Certificate, duly updated as on the date of submission of the bid

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: GST Registration Certificate Registered in India

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the valid and active GST Registration Certificate, duly updated as on the date of submission of the bid

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Copy of PAN and or TAN

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the Companys PAN and/or TAN Certificate, as applicable.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: ISO 9001:2015 Certificate of Manufacturer/suppliers Quality Management System & ISO/IEC 17025 Testing/calibration laboratory competence

Schedule of Requirements Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) EMD payment or EMD exemption shall be applicable to eligible vendors who upload the valid NSIC with MSME Certificate, as applicable, in the prescribed section of the e-Procurement portal.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- EMD payment proof or valid NSIC with MSME Certificate, as applicable, to be uploaded/enclosed.
Others -- Signed and duly filled Technical Compliance on the bidders official letterhead & to be uploaded on the e-Procurement portal.
Others -- Duly filled and signed Qualification Criteria/Checklist on the bidders official letterhead
Others -- Duly filled on the bidders official letterhead and signed Tender Form and Price Schedule, as applicable, to be uploaded on the e-Procurement portal.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of Supplier, Power of Attorney and Affidavit/Declaration

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Duly filled and signed Supplier Details, Power of Attorney, and Affidavit shall be executed on Rs.500/- stamp paper each

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Proforma for Performance Statement The bidder/authorized representative shall have supplied, installed and commissioned equipment similar in type to those specified in the Schedule of Requirements during the five financial years, i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 and shall have satisfactorily supplied, installed and commissioned at least No.10 quantity in Automatic Weather Station (AWS) & No.50 quantity in IoT Based Soil Moisture Sensors.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bidders official letterhead, along with supporting documents such as Purchase Orders/Work Orders and Performance/Satisfactory Completion Certificates
Others -- Duly filled and signed Manufacturers Authorization Form, wherever applicable.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other required documents as per the tender document
